extracted.subtask_description: Assessing and improving the quality, sourcing, neutrality, and style of a Wikipedia article; includes adding reliable citations and conforming to site style (dates/language).

rubrics_metrics.name: Relies excessively on references to primary sources
rubrics_metrics.description: This article relies excessively on references to primary sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please improve this article by adding secondary or tertiary sources. (Find sources: "Glasgow Media Group" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR.)

rubrics_metrics.name: May rely excessively on sources too closely associated with the subject
rubrics_metrics.description: This article may rely excessively on sources too closely associated with the subject, potentially preventing the article from being verifiable and neutral.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please help improve this article by replacing them with more appropriate citations to reliable, independent sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Needs additional citations for verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This article needs additional citations for verification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please help improve this article by adding citations to reliable sources. Unsourced material may be challenged and removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsourced statements warning / citation-needed policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The article contains unsourced material and/or unsourced statements (tags such as 'All articles with unsourced statements' and 'Articles with unsourced statements from November 2025').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tag assertions with citations needed, add reliable references, or remove challenged material; unsourced statements may be removed per Wikipedia policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of appropriate discovery/search channels for sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Find sources: "Glasgow Media Group" – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When addressing sourcing issues, search suggested databases and publication types (news outlets, academic books, Google Scholar, JSTOR) to find secondary/tertiary reliable citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conform to site style: date and language formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Use dmy dates from November 2022; Use British English from May 2013.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format dates using day–month–year and use British English spelling/usage consistent with the article's established conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirement for reliable, detailed references
rubrics_metrics.description: Article is flagged in categories such as 'Articles needing more detailed references' and 'Articles lacking reliable references'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Improve article verifiability by adding detailed, reliable citations; prioritize independent, authoritative sources over self-published or closely affiliated materials.
